source: quant/REPORT.md (backtest 2024-11-11..2026-11-11, 19 coins, 1h+15m, fee 0.055%/side, 0.05% slippage on market orders, real funding)
verdict: The current live rules have NO edge: -0.19R/trade (n=11837, CI95 [-0.21,-0.17]); the portfolio simulated from 45 USDT falls below 5 USDT after 2 months. RETEST is negative in every group (score, break age, direction, coin, quarter). Only BREAKOUT with SL >= 1 ATR is around breakeven/slightly positive (+0.05R, CI95 [-0.00,+0.11]) - not enough to prove an edge.

A_tighten_only_safe_to_auto_apply.change: Block the RETEST setup in both books
A_tighten_only_safe_to_auto_apply.how: lessons.json adjust.score_penalty.RETEST = 99 (current code already supports it, no script change needed)
A_tighten_only_safe_to_auto_apply.evidence: RETEST n=9876 avgR -0.230 (CI95 -0.252..-0.208); negative in 25/25 months, every score level, every break age, every SL/ATR level; OOS walk-forward still -0.26R (HIGH) / -0.18R (CORE)
A_tighten_only_safe_to_auto_apply.expected_impact: Fixed-size portfolio over 2 years: -1515 USDT -> +73 USDT; trade count 1975 -> ~530 (about 5 trades/week)

A_tighten_only_safe_to_auto_apply.evidence: n=6 avgR -0.45 with current rules; n=53 avgR -0.18 without lessons. Small sample but no sign of a positive edge.
A_tighten_only_safe_to_auto_apply.expected_impact: Very few trades affected; lowers risk

A_tighten_only_safe_to_auto_apply.change: Skip trades with SL < 1.0 x ATR(1h,14)
A_tighten_only_safe_to_auto_apply.how: Needs one more filter in run_hourly.py (new key adjust.min_sl_atr = 1.0, only rejects trades, does not loosen any rule)
A_tighten_only_safe_to_auto_apply.evidence: All 4 real losing trades had SL 0.41-0.70 ATR. Backtest: BREAKOUT with SL<1 ATR avgR -0.45..-0.83; BREAKOUT + SL>=1 ATR avgR +0.052 (n=2128), positive in both year 1 (+0.051) and year 2 (+0.054).
A_tighten_only_safe_to_auto_apply.expected_impact: Combined with A1: +73 -> +140 USDT/2 years (fixed size), maxDD 29R -> 21R

A_tighten_only_safe_to_auto_apply.change: Lower risk per trade: both books at most 1% of wallet (~0.45 USDT with a 45 wallet) instead of CORE 2 USDT / HIGH 15% of wallet
A_tighten_only_safe_to_auto_apply.how: Needs a change to the CORE_RISK / HIGH_RISK_PCT constants (or a new adjust.risk_scale) in run_hourly.py
A_tighten_only_safe_to_auto_apply.evidence: Even the best variant has maxDD ~21R. At 2 USDT / 6.75 USDT per R, 21R = 40-140 USDT > the whole wallet. Compounded simulation of live rules: wallet 45 -> 4.7 USDT on 2025-01-15 (after 173 trades). 13/18 tested variants fall below 5 USDT; the no-RETEST variant does not go to 0 but still ends at 6.3 USDT.
A_tighten_only_safe_to_auto_apply.expected_impact: No change in R/trade; reduces maximum loss by ~4-15x, avoiding blowing up the account while the edge is unproven

A_tighten_only_safe_to_auto_apply.change: Do not re-enter at the same price level (same coin, same direction, same level) a second time
A_tighten_only_safe_to_auto_apply.how: Needs a filter in run_hourly.py (read pos_state/journal)
A_tighten_only_safe_to_auto_apply.evidence: The 2nd BTC trade (11/11 01:05) re-entered at 73368 and lost. But at scale avgR is almost unchanged (-0.183 vs -0.187); if A1 is applied it has almost no effect.

A_optional_low_confidence.change: Add an SL <= 2.0 x ATR cap for BREAKOUT
A_optional_low_confidence.evidence: The SL 1-2 ATR group is best (+0.098R, n=1498) but this threshold was chosen AFTER looking at the data; year 2 is only +0.051R (CI95 -0.05..+0.15). A tighter rule in policy terms, but weak evidence.
A_optional_low_confidence.expected_impact: +140 -> +236 USDT/2 years (fixed size) if it is not luck

A_optional_low_confidence.change: Lower the daily stop from -7.5 to -3 x risk per trade (e.g. -1.5 USDT if A4)
A_optional_low_confidence.evidence: Not backtested separately; just proportional to A4.

B_needs_user_approval.change: Pause live trading (or run paper/--dry-run) until the A1+A3 rule set shows positive results over >= 50 trades
B_needs_user_approval.why_approval: Major behavior change: the user wants the bot to trade on its own
B_needs_user_approval.evidence: Even the best rule set is only +0.04..+0.05R/trade with CI95 containing 0; walk-forward OOS -0.001R (n=1597).

B_needs_user_approval.change: Raise the TP1 cap from 1.5R to 2.0R
B_needs_user_approval.evidence: Walk-forward picks 2.0R in 8/9 windows, but the average effect is ~0 (total R -494 vs -494). Not worth changing.

B_needs_user_approval.change: Change scan parameters per walk-forward (atr_buf 0.3, lookback 3, score +0.5..+1.0)
B_needs_user_approval.evidence: OOS ~0R; mostly affects RETEST (already blocked by A1).

B_needs_user_approval.change: Dynamic correlation rule (do not open 2 same-direction trades if 30-day correlation > 0.8)
B_needs_user_approval.evidence: Tried: no improvement (live -0.236R -> -0.243R; breakout+SL1ATR +0.041R -> +0.027R). The 19 coins have average correlation 0.72, so 2 same-direction trades are almost one double-size trade; better controlled by A4 (small risk) than by a 0.8 threshold.

B_needs_user_approval.change: Further research: enter BREAKOUT with limit orders (maker 0.02%) instead of market (taker 0.05%)
B_needs_user_approval.why_approval: Changes how orders are entered; not backtested yet
B_needs_user_approval.evidence: Fees + slippage take ~0.15-0.30R/trade with a tight SL; lowering fees is the biggest remaining lever.
